title: Keep a fixed sleep window
steps: Pick one sleep window you can keep for the next several nights.
Keep the same start and end times even when the work schedule shifts.

evidence.label: NASA HRP: Risk from inadequate sleep and irregular schedules (the routine change is a design proposal)

title: Adjust light around sleep
steps: In the evening before sleep, use dim light that is low in blue.
In the morning, use bright light.

evidence.label: NASA NTRS 20160006727: lighting and sleep in flight

title: Check your hydration
steps: Drink fluids steadily through the day, with a serving at your next meal.

evidence.label: Health monitoring report: review sleep, hydration, exercise load and CO2 when resting heart rate rises (design proposal)

title: Review your exercise load
steps: Check whether today's exercise was heavier or later than usual.
If time is short, shorten the session and raise the intensity instead of skipping it.

evidence.label: SPRINT study: high-intensity, lower-volume exercise gave similar results to the standard routine

title: Check CO2 near your sleeping area
steps: Read the CO2 level at your sleep station if a monitor is available.
If it looks high, ventilate or move to a better-ventilated spot, and report it.

evidence.label: NASA OCHMO-TB-004: carbon dioxide exposure limits

title: Re-measure at rest
steps: Measure again at the same site and in the same position.
For glucose, repeat the fasting reading before acting on it.

evidence.label: Health monitoring report: repeat the measurement before escalating (design proposal)
